environment.database: PostgreSQL 16 / daynori_test with Supabase schema migration v00077

rehearsals.name: V1 to V2 Account Upgrade & Schema Evolution
rehearsals.targetScenario: Provision initial account under V1 structure, evolve preferences, customize module visibility (hide Journal), and verify 100% data preservation and shell adaptation to 3 primary tabs.
rehearsals.measured: Historical notes, tasks, and routines retained byte-exact text; preferences updated; shell tabs adapted to exactly ['today', 'plan', 'library'].

rehearsals.name: Durable Save, Reopen, and Cold Cache Restart
rehearsals.targetScenario: Create multi-paragraph rich notes and priority tasks, simulate client process restart / cold cache flush, and reopen.
rehearsals.measured: All paragraphs and task attributes retrieved intact without data corruption or truncation.

rehearsals.name: Offline Mutation Outbox Queueing & Conflict-Free Replay
rehearsals.targetScenario: Enqueue optimistic note edits, task completion, and note creation in offline outbox; simulate reconnect and replay with optimistic concurrency (baseRevision).
rehearsals.measured: 3 outbox mutations replayed sequentially; server acknowledged with 200/201; server revisions updated; zero lost updates.

rehearsals.name: Provider Failure Simulation & Fail-Closed Degradation
rehearsals.targetScenario: Simulate external AI provider failure, unapproved live model calls, and Google Drive OAuth disconnection.
rehearsals.measured: Unapproved live AI model calls throw AI_PROVIDER_UNAUTHORIZED; unapproved Drive sync returns provider_gated; gateway timeout returns user-safe diagnostic feedback with local caching.

rehearsals.name: Two-Account Workspace Isolation & IDOR Fencing
rehearsals.targetScenario: Alice and Bob operate separate workspaces; Bob attempts cross-tenant read, update, and quota probe on Alice's resources.
rehearsals.measured: Cross-tenant reads and updates rejected with 403/404 via withTenantContext RLS; zero cross-tenant leakage; Alice data untouched.

rehearsals.name: Reporter-to-Operator Support Triage Workflow
rehearsals.targetScenario: Consumer user submits bug report with diagnostics; verify database persistence, unauthenticated 401 challenge, non-operator 403 forbidden, and operator 200 triage retrieval.
rehearsals.measured: Feedback stored in app.operator_feedback_submissions; unauthenticated request returned 401; non-operator returned 403; operator returned 200 with report list.

rehearsals.name: Guided Tour & Help Chapter Runnability & Gating
rehearsals.targetScenario: Verify definitions and runnability for 10 everyday, 5 advanced, and 4 safe explanatory chapters; verify 6 capability-gated chapters reject safely with feature_gated.
rehearsals.measured: 19 chapters runnable; 6 capability-gated chapters return ok: false with code: feature_gated.

rehearsals.name: Function Register Reconciliation & Release Gate Barriers
rehearsals.targetScenario: Reconcile all 109 function register actions; verify 78 verified_local, 10 unverified, 21 blocked, 0 release_ready; verify DEF-V2-001 through DEF-V2-012 defect references.
rehearsals.measured: 100% of function register actions reconciled; release gate barriers enforced without unauthorized release_ready claims.
